title: Natalie
summary:
With a passion for financial management, Natalie established Bookkeeping On The Go in 2002. Her vision was to empower business owners with a comprehensive understanding of their financial direction and positioning, thereby facilitating their growth.

Natalie’s enthusiasm lies in the diverse nature of working with various entities daily, as opposed to being confined to a single entity. She derives great satisfaction from educating clients on various aspects of bookkeeping and financial management.

Originally from Victoria, she relocated to Western Australia in 2000, where she decided to establish her family and subsequently, her business. Since then, she has consistently strived for excellence and has never looked back.

Natalie holds the distinction of being a Registered BAS Agent and possesses a Certificate IV in Financial Services (Bookkeeping).

title: Ellie
summary:
Ellie has over five years of bookkeeping experience and holds a Bachelor of Business (Accounting major) along with a Certificate IV in Accounting and Bookkeeping. She is a Registered BAS Agent, further strengthening her ability to support our clients with expert compliance and bookkeeping services.

Since joining Bookkeeping On The Go in 2023, Ellie has worked across almost every aspect of client bookkeeping — including coding, payroll, reconciliations, BAS preparation, and annual lodgements.

Passionate about numbers, Ellie has a sharp eye for detail and loves making everything balance. She prides herself on delivering accurate, thoroughly reviewed work, giving clients the confidence that their books are always in safe hands.

Outside of work, Ellie enjoys gaming and reading, where she loves immersing herself in different worlds. Most of all, she treasures spending time with her family and is especially excited to welcome her twin daughters arriving in October.
